snippet.title: Total Trails - PlayStation 5 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Total Trails is here to provide you with the most authentic mountain biking experience ever. We've taken realism to the next level, ensuring that you feel every bump, every turn, and every adrenaline rush as you navigate challenging trails.

Embark on an epic mountain biking journey through meticulously crafted trails. Master your biking techniques, manage momentum, and adapt to dynamic terrains in a variety of stunning environments, including forests, mountains, meadows and more. Each location presents unique challenges that will test your skills.

Whether you're a biking pro or just looking for an adrenaline-pumping adventure, get your helmets on and prepare to hit the trails like never before.

Are you ready to conquer Total Trails?

Developed by Repixel8
